techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane Group's first and flagship campus (launched 2001) on 42 acres at Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar, bordering HAL and DRDO land east of the old HAL airport: about ten buildings - Olympia, Lakeview, Tridib, Laurel, Parin, Quay, Commerz, Crown and a dedicated Cognizant building - totalling 4.7 msf, with Bagmane's own head office on the 5th floor of Laurel Block B. The new 3.5 msf Bagmane Cosmos (Ariel, Vesta, Ceres) rises on its eastern edge. Anchors are Texas Instruments' India HQ (Lakeview), Dell's R&D centre, Volvo Group India's head office (Tridib), Cognizant, PwC's Acceleration Center and Palo Alto Networks (Quay), Motorola Solutions and Nike (Olympia), Infineon and OpenText/Micro Focus (Laurel), Grant Thornton (Tridib) and Lam Research.

techParks.name: Bagmane Cosmos
techParks.description: Bagmane's newest C.V. Raman Nagar campus (launched 2022, under development) immediately east of Bagmane Tech Park: five planned blocks of which Ariel (550,000 sq ft, Texas Instruments), Vesta (496,800 sq ft, Lam Research and Palo Alto Networks) and Ceres (550,000 sq ft) are named, 3.5 msf in all. It is the Bagmane REIT's growth asset in this cluster.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: A 28-acre SEZ campus (2007) on the K.R. Puram-Marathahalli stretch of the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura, 4.5 msf across gem-named blocks: Aquamarine (Visa, Ericsson, Mphasis' corporate HQ), Citrine (Ericsson, Arm, Microland), Peridot (Accenture, AB InBev GCC), Amber (Boeing, Extreme Networks), Moonstone / the Dell EMC towers, Coral (EY GDS), the 993,000 sq ft Goldstone tower (Samsung R&D, Nvidia) and Opal (Google). Google's Bagmane Rio campus adjoins it to the west and Bagmane Constellation to the south.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: A 30-acre, 5.3 msf campus (2007) at Ferns City, Doddanekundi, on the Outer Ring Road south of Bagmane WTC, with towers named for constellations: Phoenix (Samsung R&D Institute India-Bangalore, #2870), Virgo (Qualcomm's 2.56 lakh sq ft 2025 lease), Carina East and West (Google, Red Hat), Orion, Aquila and Taurus 1-4 (Amazon's BLR14 and sister buildings; Arm's new 409,450 sq ft Taurus-4 North Tower). Bagmane also lists Boeing and Nvidia as occupiers.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's largest ORR campus (launched 2017, 42 acres, 10.5 msf planned) east of Constellation at Doddanekundi Circle, with towers named for world cities: Luxor South and North (GSK's GCC, IBM/Apptio, EPAM, Encora, HCLTech, FAB), Kyoto West and East (Google's 8.7 lakh sq ft 'Kyoto Campus'), Rome South and North (Amazon, American Express), Angkor East and West (Qualcomm, Wayfair, Samsung Semiconductor India Research), Apollo, Troy (Synopsys) and the under-construction Memphis towers. Bagmane also lists Microsoft, BNP Paribas, Databricks and Arm; the Luxor campus (~1 msf) is being folded into the Bagmane REIT.

techParks.name: Bagmane Rio Business Park
techParks.description: An 8-acre, 12-storey single-tenant campus (2018) immediately west of Bagmane WTC on the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura - 1.6 msf built (about 1.1 msf leasable per the REIT) - fully leased to Google as its 'Ananta' campus, described as one of Google's largest offices anywhere. The Bagmane REIT is acquiring a 93% stake.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: An 82-acre campus (launched 2017, 10.5 msf planned) on ITPL Main Road at the cusp of the Outer Ring Road and Whitefield, between Doddanekundi and Kundalahalli, with blocks named for noble gases - Neon, Xenon North and South, Argon, Helium, Radon - plus numbered buildings on the ITPL Main Road side. Occupiers include Cognizant, Carelon Global Solutions (Xenon South), Shell Business Operations, Schneider Electric's 0.48 msf R&D centre, Tekion, Northern Trust, Baker Hughes, Zebra Technologies, Omnicom/DDB and Visteon, with OSM also recording AMD, IBM, SAP Fioneer, Thermo Fisher, Harman, o9 and Netskope.

coverageNotes: LENS: the C.V. Raman Nagar cluster (Bagmane Tech Park + the adjoining new Bagmane Cosmos) is covered building by building. Bagmane WTC/Goldstone, Constellation, Capital and Rio are a SEPARATE cluster ~4 km east on the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura/Doddanekundi, and Solarium City is further out on ITPL Main Road; they are included because the roster named Google (Bagmane), Dell EMC, Amazon, Nvidia and Shell, all of which sit there, so expect overlap with the ORR/Mahadevapura and Whitefield lenses. EVIDENCE LIMITS: the shared WebSearch budget ran out after the first six searches, so verification was done by fetching known URLs. Confirmed from company pages: Palo Alto Networks (Quay), Grant Thornton (Tridib), Lam Research (Crown Building + Cosmos), Arm (Taurus-4 North), Synopsys (Troy), Microland (Citrine), Carelon (Xenon South), Google (Rio 'Ananta', Kyoto West, Old Madras Road). From lease reporting: Qualcomm (Virgo, Nov 2025), Google (Kyoto E/W renewal, 2025), Arm (Taurus-4, Jan 2026), Samsung (Goldstone renewal, Jul 2024), Schneider Electric (Solarium, Nov 2023). Everything else rests on Bagmane's own per-building occupier tables plus OSM POIs, graded high only where both agree on the building, medium where only the developer names the company, low where only an OSM POI does. Company contact pages for Mphasis, Volvo Group India, Texas Instruments, Commvault, Infineon, OpenText, PwC, Finastra, Tekion and ZaubaCorp registry pages were unreachable (404/403), so TI, Volvo, Dell and Mphasis HQ claims are developer-page + OSM, not primary. NOT CONFIRMED / LEFT OUT: Oracle Financial Services and HSBC appear only in Wikipedia/NoBroker tenant lists and not on Bagmane's current occupier wall, so they are low/medium and may be historical. Wikipedia's Bagmane Tech Park list also names Alstom Transport, Juniper Networks, Lenovo, HP/HPE, Ogilvy, Tecnotree, CME Group, Dover, Netserv and Sasken - left out as unverified and probably dated (Sasken's HQ is Domlur; Lenovo India's HQ is Ferns Icon next to Bagmane WTC, not a Bagmane building). Roster names with no Bagmane evidence found: Nokia (Manyata), Sony (Embassy Tech Village), LG Soft (Embassy Tech Square), Yahoo, Capgemini, Micron, Bosch, Siemens, Collins Aerospace, Yokogawa, Apple, Infosys, TCS - none has a Bagmane office in any source consulted, so they are omitted here and belong to other lenses. COORDINATES: every lat/lng is an OSM office POI or OSM building footprint except where geocodeSource says park-centroid (Lam's Crown Building, Cisco, Informatica, HSBC, Oracle@BTP, Boeing@Constellation, Nvidia@Constellation, Arm@Capital, Microsoft, BNP Paribas, Databricks, Visteon, Carelon@Manyata) or manual-known (Grant Thornton's WeWork Galaxy). Bagmane Goldstone is treated as a building of Bagmane WTC (as Bagmane's own page does) rather than a separate park. Headcounts are null throughout: no source gave a Bengaluru-specific figure (Schneider's 4,800 is lease capacity, Mphasis' 31,645 is global). Second TI POI in Whitefield (OSM node/13055677870), an Ericsson POI at Rio Tower 1 and Volvo's Hoskote plant were seen but not included for lack of corroboration or coordinates.
